settings.title: return policy
settings.content:
Return Fees

Please note that we charge a $15 return fee. This helps cover the costs associated with processing returns.

Return Condition

All returned merchandise must include all original packaging and accessories. 

Redo at Checkout

When you opt-in for Redo at checkout, your return shipping label is FREE, allowing you to return any item(s) in your order for a refund without covering the shipping.

  • Restocking fees still apply.

Received a Damage or wrong product?

If your machine arrived damaged or you have received the wrong product please contact us at

customerservice@grillbots.com

settings.title: Grillbot Return Policy
settings.answer:
Grillbot 60 Days Money-Back Guarantee

If you'd like to return a Grillbot for a refund, you need to do so within 60 days from the delivery date.

NOT COVERED:

Misuse due to direct contact with fire, water damage, or falls off the grill due to not closing the lid, or use on any surface other than a barbecue grill.

settings.title: Smart Apron Return Policy
settings.answer:
Smart Apron Return Policy

The Smart Apron is covered by our 60 Days Money-Back Guarantee. If you'd like to return it for a refund, you need to do so within 60 days from the delivery date.

  • A $15 return fee applies. This helps cover the costs of processing returns.
  • All returned merchandise must include the apron, Command Center, Meat Thermometer, neck strap, charging cable, and all original packaging.
  • When you opt-in for Redo at checkout, your return shipping label is FREE.
  • Restocking fees still apply.

Please note: the Meat Thermometer is a food-contact item.

The Smart Apron includes a Bluetooth Meat Thermometer that is inserted directly into food. For hygiene and food-safety reasons, a thermometer that has been used in food cannot be returned for a refund and is considered final sale, the same way other food-contact items are.

To qualify for a money-back refund, the Smart Apron and all its parts must come back unused, in new condition, and in the original packaging.

This is separate from your warranty. If a used Smart Apron develops a genuine defect in its tech module (the Command Center speaker, LED light, Meat Thermometer, or charging system), it is covered by the limited warranty rather than the return policy.

Register your Smart Apron and contact us, and we will arrange a repair or replacement.

Received a damaged or wrong product?

Inspect your order on arrival. If your Smart Apron arrived damaged or you received the wrong product, contact us at customerservice@grillbots.com and we will arrange a prompt replacement.

NOT COVERED:

  • Normal wear and tear
  • Drops or falls
  • Direct contact with fire or excessive heat
  • Water damage, including washing the Command Center or leaving the product outside
  • Failure to follow the operating instructions
  • Damage from accessories or parts not made by Grillbot

settings.title: FlipTray Return Policy
settings.answer:
• Returnable within 60 days if unopened and unused
  • Must include original packaging and accessories
  • Used or food-contact FlipTrays are final sale

Contact us if you receive a damaged or incorrect item

settings.title: Heat Shields Return Policy
settings.answer: It depends on where you are. Orders processed here will take 5-7 business days to arrive. Overseas deliveries can take anywhere from 7-16 days. Delivery details will be provided in your confirmation email.

settings.title: Grillbot Accessories Return Policy
settings.answer:
Accessories - including brushes, batteries, skins, quick-release connectors, and other add-ons are not eligible for return or warranty coverage unless they arrive with a manufacturer defect or returned unused as part of a gift order.

Not Covered:

  • Regular wear and tear
  • Accidental damage or misuse
  • Cosmetic blemishes not affecting function

settings.form_content:
To return products please complete the following steps:

  1. Submit the form below. Our team will respond with return authorization information within 48 hours.
  2. Package the item(s) to be returned in the original Grillbot packaging with all accessories included.

Please note:

  • Unauthorized or COD returns will not be accepted.
  • Please allow 4-8 weeks for return processing.
  • Products returned to Grillbot, LLC will receive a full refund.

settings.title: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Fill out the form above or click HERE

settings.title: Does Grillbot cover return shipping?
settings.answer:
We offer free shipping for returns. However, please note that we charge a $15 return fee. This helps cover the costs associated with processing returns.

We Offer Return Protection with REDO

When you opt-in for Redo at checkout, your return shipping label is FREE, allowing you to return any item(s) in your order for a refund or store credit without covering the shipping.

*Return fees still apply.

If you decide not to buy Redo or if you prefer a full refund, you can still return your items, but you will be responsible for the full return fee ($15).

settings.title: Can I return a Grillbot purchased on Amazon to Grillbot, LLC warehouse?
settings.answer: If you purchased your Grillbot through Amazon, the return process needs to be initiated through your Amazon account. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept returns directly at the Grillbot, LLC warehouse for items purchased via Amazon. To start a return, please log in to your Amazon account and follow their return procedure. This ensures that your return is processed efficiently and in accordance with Amazon's policies. If you need assistance with the Amazon return process or have any other questions, feel free to contact our customer support team for help.

settings.title: Can I exchange one Grillbot for another?
settings.answer: Yes, you can exchange your Grillbot for another. However, there are a couple of conditions to keep in mind for a successful exchange. First, the Grillbot you wish to exchange must be unopened and unused. We are committed to ensuring all our customers receive brand-new, high-quality products. Secondly, please be aware that you will be responsible for any shipping fees incurred during the exchange process. This includes the cost of sending the original Grillbot back to us and the shipping for the new model. To initiate an exchange, please contact our customer support team, who will guide you through the process and provide any necessary details.

settings.title: When can I expect my refund?
settings.answer: After you have returned your Grillbot product, our dedicated team will process and inspect the returned item. The timeline for receiving your refund depends on the completion of this process. Once the return is successfully processed and the item has been inspected, we will initiate the refund. Please note that the time it takes for the refund to be reflected in your account can vary depending on your bank or credit card issuer. Rest assured, we strive to handle all returns promptly and will work to ensure your refund is processed as quickly as possible. If you have any questions or concerns about your specific refund, feel free to reach out to our customer support team for assistance.

settings.title: How will I be refunded?
settings.answer: Your refund will be processed using the original payment method you used for the purchase. The timeframe for the refund to reflect in your account depends on your bank or payment provider. Our team aims to process refunds quickly once returns are approved. For further assistance, please contact our customer support.

settings.title: How does Grillbot handle return requests that are past the 60-day return window?
settings.answer: For return requests beyond the 60-day window, we assess each case individually. Our approach is to understand the specific reason for the late return request and work collaboratively with the client to find a satisfactory resolution. We value our customers and strive to provide flexible solutions whenever possible. If you find yourself in this situation, please contact our customer support team to discuss your options.

settings.title: What happens to my refund if I return a Grillbot product that was a gift?
settings.answer: In the case of returning a Grillbot product that was received as a gift, please note that we can only process refunds to the original payment method used for the purchase. This means the refund will be issued to the person who bought the gift. We recommend coordinating with the gift giver for such situations. For any further assistance or queries, our customer support team is available to help.

settings.title: Can I return my Grillbot purchase without a receipt?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, we require a receipt to process any returns of Grillbot products. The receipt is essential to confirm your purchase and assist in efficiently handling your return. If you have misplaced your receipt, please contact our customer support team, and we will do our best to help you based on the details of your purchase.

settings.title: Does Grillbots.com accept returns of Grillbot products purchased from another retailer?
settings.answer: We do not accept returns for Grillbot products that were purchased from other retailers. For returns of products bought from external retailers, please contact the store or platform where you originally made the purchase. They will assist you with their specific return policy and process. If you have any questions about our products, feel free to reach out to our customer support team.
